packageRules.description: Hold go-sdk at 1.6.x. v1.7.0 implements protocol 2026-07-28, which replaces resources/updated with a single subscriptions/listen stream and removes resources/subscribe and resources/unsubscribe outright (they answer MethodNotFound). SubscriptionBroker and its wiring are built on the removed calls, so TestSubscription_EndToEnd times out waiting for a notification that the new protocol never sends. That is a migration of the subscription architecture, not a version bump. The same release also deprecates roots (SEP-2577), which trips staticcheck in internal/tools/roots.go. Drop this rule with the migration.
Group all Go module updates into one PR
Group all GitHub Actions updates into one PR
Pin the Go base image in the Containerfile using docker versioning
